Hello,
The value is correctly sent to our backend, but the problem is that the value of the AC meter index that we can see physically on the side of the charger is not equal with the value remotely sent.
When I was on site, you can see on photos that the AC meter index was 8839.85 kWh so normally the charger should have remotely sent 8839850 wh.
